name: Famine
value: Famine risk in Darfur, Kordofan; none new
summary: UN agencies warn of famine risk in parts of Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine as of 28 Nov
state: The UN Human Rights Office warned on 19 Nov of famine risk in parts of Darfur and Kordofan, where strikes on markets and movement restrictions are cutting food access (Defense Post). WFP's 2027 Global Outlook, issued on 20 Nov, puts 266 million people in acute hunger. Searches on 28 Nov found no area newly classified as Famine (IPC Phase 5), so Watch holds.
for_you: People in conflict-hit areas of Sudan, South Sudan and other hotspots are most exposed. Famine risk tends to rise where fighting blocks aid convoys and markets, and when the lean season arrives.
rubric_hit: Watch: 'risk of famine' warnings for Darfur and Kordofan; no new IPC Phase 5 classification found

sources.title: The Defense Post — UN says drone strikes caused most civilian deaths in Sudan

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
